title: Data store 'Update a record' blanks every field you did not map
symptoms: Fields that held values before an update are empty afterwards
cause: Update a record writes the whole record, and unmapped fields are written as empty.
fix: Map every field on every update, carrying unchanged values from an earlier Get or Search.
apply: In each UpdateRecord, map all structure fields and use {{N.data.field}} from the preceding search for the ones you are not changing.
